words.gram: pres. part. mid. √brū, m. nom. sg.
n. acc. pl. (Vedic janimā, from janiman)

hindi: उशना की तरह काव्य बोलता हुआ देव देवगण के जन्मों को प्रकट करता है; महान व्रत वाला, उज्ज्वल बन्धु वाला, पावक वराह एक पग से आगे आता है, गरजता हुआ।
english: Speaking a poem like Uśanā, the god declares the births of the gods; of great ordinance, of bright kin, the purifier, the boar comes up with a step, roaring.
notes: Uśanā is a name, no role stated. varāha is taken literally as boar. janimā is the Vedic plural of janiman. pra ... vivakti is a split verb. Reused from a reviewed final after checking; the old rendering added 'his' and 'with his step', removed here.

hindi: आगे हंस; वृषभों के समूह गए। हे मित्रो, वे साथ मिलकर शुद्ध होते हुए को, कठिनता से सहे जाने वाले शब्द को आगे बोलते हैं।
english: Forth the swans [unclear], toward the sound [unclear]; the troops of bulls went. O friends, together they speak forth the [unclear] clarifying one, the sound hard to bear.
notes: Very obscure. tṛpalā, mādastam and āṅgoṣiṇam are not understood and are left [unclear]; vagnum 'sound' and acchā 'toward' are taken as the surface reading. The word division of the second token is a guess. No text_flag is raised because no specific correction is certain.

hindi: वह दूर-दूर तक गाए जाने वाले की गति को जोड़ता है; स्वच्छन्द खेलते हुए के प्रति वे गायों की तरह रँभाते हैं। तीखे सींगों वाला प्रचुरता रचता है; दिन में भूरा दिखाई देता है, रात में लाल।
english: He yokes the impulse of the widely praised one; they bellow at the one playing freely, like cows. Sharp-horned, he makes abundance; by day the tawny one is seen, by night the ruddy one.
notes: yojata is printed for yojate (3 sg. mid.), not flagged. na after mimate is read as a simile particle (like cows); the alternative 'the cows do not bellow' is not adopted. urugāya 'widely praised' is a choice; ṛjra 'ruddy' is uncertain. Subject of kṛṇute is taken as the same as sa.

hindi: गूँजते हुए सोम धन के लिए आगे बढ़ चले, रथों की तरह, घोड़ों की तरह सहायता चाहने वाले।
english: The resounding Somas have strode forth for wealth, like chariots, like steeds seeking help.
notes: svānāsaḥ may stand for suvānāsaḥ 'being pressed'; noted only, not applied. The token 'ivārvanto' is iva + arvantaḥ, and na is a second simile particle ('like steeds'). Whether avasyavaḥ qualifies the steeds or the Somas is open.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √hi, m. nom. pl.

hindi: प्रेरित होते हुए वे रथों की तरह दोनों हाथों में दौड़ पड़े हैं, कर्मियों के भार की तरह।
english: Impelled, they have run like chariots in the two hands, like the loads of the workers.
notes: bharāsaḥ 'loads' and kārin 'worker' are uncertain; kārin might also be 'singer'. The subject of dadhanvire is not stated.

hindi: राजाओं की तरह प्रशंसाओं से सोम दूध से सजाए जाते हैं, यज्ञ की तरह सात धारण करने वालों से।
english: Like kings with praises, the Somas are adorned with milk, like a sacrifice with seven supporters.
notes: gobhiḥ is literally 'with cows'; 'milk' is the usual sense in this setting. dhātṛ 'supporter, establisher'.

hindi: गूँजती हुई बूँदें आनन्द के लिए, बलपूर्वक स्तुति के साथ, मधु की धारा में चारों ओर बहती हैं।
english: The resounding drops flow around, for exhilaration, mightily with song, in a stream of the sweet drink.
notes: Reused from a reviewed final after checking. barhaṇā is uncertain ('mightily', or an instrumental agreeing with girā). svānāsaḥ may stand for suvānāsaḥ; noted only. indu is 'drop' per glossary.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. ā-√pā, m. nom. pl. (uncertain)

hindi: पीते हुए, विवस्वान् के, उषा के भाग्य को प्रेरित करते हुए, सूर्य सूक्ष्म को फैलाते हैं।
english: Drinking, of Vivasvat, quickening the fortune of Dawn, the suns stretch out the fine one.
notes: Obscure. āpānāsaḥ could be from ā-√pā 'drinking' or √āp 'having obtained'; sūrāḥ could be 'suns' or 'patrons'; aṇvam has no noun, so none is supplied. Vivasvat taken as the name in the text.

hindi: प्राचीन गायक स्तुतियों के द्वार खोलते हैं, बलवान की ज्वाला के लोग।
english: The ancient singers open the doors of the prayers, the people of the mighty one's flame.
notes: apa ... ṛṇvanti is read as 'open'. The second half is verbless and the connection of vṛṣṇaḥ, harasaḥ and āyavaḥ is uncertain; haras 'flame, glow' is a guess.

hindi: एकजुट होता, सात पत्नियों वाले, एक के, पूर्ण करने वाले के स्थान तक पहुँचे।
english: The united Hotṛ priests, seven-wived, attained the place of the one, of the one filling.
notes: sapta-jānayaḥ read as 'having seven wives' (jāni, wife); this is uncertain. piprataḥ may be 'filling' or 'carrying across'.

hindi: नाभि से मैं हमारी नाभि को ग्रहण करता हूँ, आँख से, हे सूर्य, देखने के लिए; मैं कवि की संतान को दुहता हूँ।
english: With the navel I take hither our navel, with the eye, O Sūrya, to see; I milk hither the offspring of the seer.
notes: na is read as naḥ (aḥ before ā); it could be dative 'for us'. sūrya is read as vocative; 'the sun' (accusative) is possible. duhe could also be 3 sg. 'he milks'. The sense is obscure.

hindi: आकाश के प्रिय स्थान की ओर, अध्वर्युओं द्वारा गुप्त रूप से रखे हुए की ओर, सूर्य आँख से देखता है।
english: Toward the dear place of heaven, placed in secret by the Adhvaryus, the sun sees with the eye.
notes: sūra read as 'sun' (patron is possible). In Hindi गुप्त रूप से renders guhā 'in secret'.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √vid, m. nom. pl. (Vedic vidānā)

hindi: बूँदें सत्य के धर्म में मार्ग से छोड़ी गईं, अत्यन्त शोभायमान, इसके जोड़ने के कर्मों को जानती हुई।
english: The drops, very splendid, were released by the path in the dharma of truth, knowing the yokings of this one.
notes: dharman rendered 'dharma' per glossary (the open point 'ordinance' is not applied). vidānāḥ 'knowing' (alternative 'finding'). yojanā 'yokings' is uncertain. 'Hindi जोड़ने के कर्म' stands for yojanā 'yokings'.

hindi: मधु की धारा से अग्रणी महान जलों में आगे बढ़कर उतरता है; हवियों में हवि, वन्दना के योग्य।
english: With a stream of the sweet drink the foremost one plunges forth through the great waters; an offering among offerings, worthy of praise.
notes: dhārā is read as an instrumental (agriyaḥ is masculine); it could also be a nominative 'the stream ... plunges'.

hindi: आगे, वाणी के साथी के साथ, अग्रणी बलवान वन में स्थान की ओर गरजा है; सच्चा यज्ञ।
english: Forth, with the yoke-fellow of speech, the foremost mighty one has roared in the wood toward the seat; true, the rite.
notes: vṛṣo acikradat stands for vṛṣaḥ acikradat (printed without avagraha). The sense of yujā vācaḥ is uncertain; vana 'wood' might be a vessel. satyaḥ adhvaraḥ is verbless.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √pū, m. nom. sg.

words.gloss: racer of the light of heaven

hindi: जब कवि पवित्र होता हुआ काव्यों, पौरुषों के चारों ओर बहता है, सूर्य का प्रकाश पाने वाला धावक जीतना चाहता है।
english: When the seer, purifying, flows around the poems and manly powers, the racer of the light of heaven desires to win.
notes: kāvya is rendered 'poem' and nṛmṇa 'manly power'. svarvājin is a compound of svar (light of heaven) and vājin (racer); the exact link is uncertain.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √pū, m. nom. sg.

hindi: शुद्ध होने वाला शत्रुओं की ओर, प्रजाओं पर राजा की तरह बैठता है, जब विधान करने वाले उसे प्रेरित करते हैं।
english: The clarifying one, toward the rivals, sits on the clans like a king, when the ordainers urge him on.
notes: abhi is taken with sīdati ('sits upon'), and spṛdhaḥ is also taken as governed by it; the construction is uncertain. īm is 'him' (particle-pronoun).

hindi: प्रिय भूरा, भेड़ के बाल की छन्नी पर, वनों में चारों ओर बैठता है; गरजने वाला प्रयत्न करता है।
english: Dear, the tawny one sits around on the strainer of fleece, in the woods; the roarer strives, [unclear] prayer.
notes: avyā and mati are not clear in case; mati may stand for matī or matim, so the end is left [unclear]. vana 'woods' may refer to wooden vessels.

hindi: वह मद के साथ वायु, इन्द्र, दोनों अश्विन् के पास जाता है, जो इसके धर्म से।
english: He goes with exhilaration to Vāyu, Indra, the two Aśvins; he who, [unclear], by the dharma of this one.
notes: raṇā is not clear (delight, battle?) and the relative clause is incomplete. dharman rendered 'dharma' per glossary (flag: 'ordinance' is possible). No 'and' is added between the asyndetic accusatives.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √vid, m. nom. pl. (Vedic vidānā)

hindi: मधु की तरंगें मित्र, वरुण, भग तक बहती हैं, इसकी सामर्थ्य से जानती हुई।
english: The waves of the sweet drink flow to Mitra, Varuṇa, Bhaga, knowing by the capacities of this one.
notes: pavanta printed for pavante. Bhaga is read as the deity in a list. śakman 'capacity' is a choice.

hindi: हमारे लिए, हे दोनों लोक, धन; मधु के, वाज को जीतने के लिए; कीर्ति, संपदाएँ, साथ जीता हुआ।
english: For us, O two worlds, wealth; of the sweet drink, for the winning of the prize; fame, goods, jointly won.
notes: Verbless. The printed ~ after asmabhya is the regular nasal of final m. sañjitam might be a participle 'won together' or a noun 'conquest'; no verb is supplied.

hindi: यहाँ आज हम तुम्हारे कौशल का वरण करते हैं, कल्याणकारी, वहन करने वाले, रक्षक, यहाँ, बहुत चाहे गए।
english: Hither today we choose your skill, bringing welfare, the carrier, the protecting one, hither, much desired.
notes: Reused from a reviewed final after checking against the glossary (dakṣa = skill). The first ā goes with vṛṇīmahe. pāntam may be 'protecting' or 'drinking'.

hindi: यहाँ आनन्ददायक, यहाँ वरण करने योग्य, यहाँ प्रेरित मेधावी, यहाँ मनीषी; यहाँ रक्षक, बहुत चाहे गए।
english: Hither the gladdening, hither the desirable, hither the inspired one, the inspired one (manīṣin); hither the protecting, the much desired.
notes: Verbless; no verb is supplied (the parallel verse supplies none in the text here). The repeated ā is rendered 'hither' each time. vipra and manīṣin are given the glossary renderings.

hindi: यहाँ धन, यहाँ सुबुद्धि वाले, हे उत्तम शक्ति वाले, शरीरों में यहाँ; यहाँ रक्षक, बहुत चाहे गए।
english: Hither wealth, hither the clear-minded, O one of good power, in the bodies hither; hither the protecting, the much desired.
notes: Verbless. sucetuna 'clear-minded' is uncertain. Hindi शक्ति renders kratu in sukrato.

hindi: आकाश का शीर्ष, पृथ्वी का यात्री, वैश्वानर, ऋत में जन्मा अग्नि, कवि, सम्राट, लोगों का अतिथि; मुख में हमारे लिए देवगण ने पात्र उत्पन्न किया।
english: The head of heaven, the traveller of earth, Vaiśvānara, Agni born in truth, the seer, sovereign, guest of the people; in the mouth for us the gods generated a vessel.
notes: aratim is uncertain ('traveller'; 'attendant, ruler' also possible). ṛta ā jātam is read as ṛte ā jātam 'born in truth'. The words āsan naḥ are one reading of the last token; 'mouth' is the literal sense and no owner is added. The verbless first half is left as a series of accusatives.

words.gram: pres. part. pass. √jan, m. acc. sg.

hindi: हे अमर, सब देवगण तुम्हें जन्म लेते हुए, शिशु की तरह, साथ मिलकर स्तुति करते हैं; तुम्हारी शक्तियों से उन्होंने अमरत्व पाया, हे वैश्वानर, जब तुम दोनों माता-पिता के लिए चमके।
english: O immortal one, all the gods praise you together, being born, like a child; by your powers they attained immortality, O Vaiśvānara, when you shone for the two parents.
notes: The printed ~ after jāyamāna is the regular nasal. The subject of āyan is taken as the gods. pitroḥ is dual 'of the two parents'; the genitive is rendered with 'for'.

hindi: उन्होंने साथ मिलकर यज्ञों की नाभि, धनों का आसन, महान द्रोण की स्तुति की; देवगण ने वैश्वानर, यज्ञों का रथ-अश्व, यज्ञ का ध्वज उत्पन्न किया।
english: They praised together the navel of sacrifices, the seat of riches, the great trough; the gods generated Vaiśvānara, the chariot-horse of the rites, the banner of the sacrifice.
notes: āhāvam 'trough' is uncertain (also 'invocation'). rathya 'chariot-horse' follows the glossary. The subject of navanta is not stated. mahām is read as a masculine accusative of mahā.

hindi: तुम्हारे लिए आगे गाओ, मित्र के लिए, वरुण के लिए, प्रेरित स्तुति से; दो महान प्रभुत्व वाले, महान सत्य।
english: Sing forth for you, for Mitra, for Varuṇa, with inspired song; the two of great dominion, the great truth.
notes: The token mahikṣatrāvṛtam is read as mahikṣatrau ṛtam. vaḥ is an ethical dative and could be 'your'. The relation of the last words to the sentence is open.

hindi: जो घी-स्रोत वाले दोनों सम्राट, मित्र और वरुण दोनों, देवगण में प्रशंसित दो देव।
english: The two sovereigns who have ghee as their source, both Mitra and Varuṇa, the two gods praised among the gods.
notes: Verbless relative construction; no copula is supplied in either language.

hindi: वे दोनों हमारे लिए पार्थिव, महान, दिव्य धन पर समर्थ बनो; महान है तुम दोनों का प्रभुत्व देवगण में।
english: Those two, have power for us over earthly, great, heavenly wealth; great is the dominion of you two among the gods.

text_flags.why: possible typo: short a for ā; parthiva is not a word

notes: The grammar of śaktam with the genitives is uncertain. The copula is supplied in both languages in the second half.

hindi: हे इन्द्र, हे अद्भुत दीप्ति वाले, आओ; ये निचोड़े गए, तुम्हें चाहने वाले, सूक्ष्मों के द्वारा शुद्ध किए गए।
english: Come, O Indra of wonderful radiance; these pressed ones, desiring you, purified by the fine ones, [unclear].
notes: tanā is not clear and is left [unclear]. aṇvībhiḥ is read as 'fine ones' with no noun supplied.

words.gloss: of the one who has pressed

hindi: हे इन्द्र, आओ, विचार से प्रेरित, प्रेरित मेधावी से चलाए गए; निचोड़ने वाले के, उपासक के पवित्र वचनों के पास।
english: Come, O Indra, urged by thought, impelled by the inspired one, to the sacred words of the one who has pressed, of the worshipper.
notes: sutāvataḥ and vāghataḥ are read as genitive singular; plurals 'to the pressers, the worshippers' are possible.

hindi: हे इन्द्र, आओ, पवित्र वचनों के पास शीघ्रता करते हुए, हे भूरे घोड़ों वाले; निचोड़ने पर हम पर आनन्द प्रदान करो।
english: Come, O Indra, hastening to the sacred words, O owner of bay horses; at the pressing bestow delight on us.
notes: naḥ with dadhiṣva is ambiguous (dative 'on us' or 'our'). harivaḥ follows the glossary (owner of bay horses).

words.gram: pres. part. pari-√svaj, m. nom. sg.

hindi: उसकी स्तुति करो जो ज्वाला से सब वनों का आलिंगन करता हुआ जीभ से काला करता है।
english: Praise him who, embracing all the woods with flame, makes black with the tongue.
notes: No name (Agni) is given in the text, so none is added. kṛṣṇā is taken as the object complement 'black'. pariṣvajat could also be a finite injunctive.

hindi: जो मर्त्य निश्चय ही इन्द्र की कृपा का आदर करता है; द्युम्न के लिए सरलता से पार होने वाले जल।
english: The mortal who indeed honours the favour of Indra; for splendour, easily crossed waters.
notes: ya iddha is read as yaḥ id ha; 'kindled' (iddha) does not fit the sentence. The second half is verbless and apaḥ could also be 'works'. sutarā is printed for sutarāḥ.

hindi: तुम दोनों हमारे लिए वाज से युक्त पोषण, द्रुतगामी घोड़ों को भर दो, इन्द्र और अग्नि को यहाँ ले आने के लिए।
english: You two, fill for us the refreshments rich in prize, the swift steeds, to carry hither Indra and Agni.
notes: vājavatīḥ is not split at -vat. 'tā' is taken as the nominative dual 'you two'. pipṛtam may also be 'bring across'.

hindi: बूँद इन्द्र के निश्चित स्थान की ओर आगे गई; मित्र मित्र की प्रतिज्ञा नहीं तोड़ता। जैसे युवक युवतियों के साथ, वैसे सोम कलश में सौ गतियों वाले मार्ग से साथ-साथ दौड़ता है।
english: Forth went the drop to the appointed place of Indra; a friend does not break the pledge of a friend. Like a young man with young women, Soma hastens together in the vessel by the path of a hundred courses.
notes: pro is pra u; the particle u is left untranslated in both languages. niṣkṛta 'appointed place' is uncertain (also 'prepared'). The Hindi वैसे is the correlative of the iva simile.

hindi: आगे तुम्हारी बुद्धियाँ, आनन्ददायक को चाहने वाली, विस्मय चाहने वाली, प्रशंसा चाहने वाली, घेरों में बढ़ चलीं; खेलते हुए भूरे को स्तुति-गीतों ने सराहा; गायों ने दूध से निश्चय ही मिलाया।
english: Forth your thoughts, desiring the gladdening, desiring wonder, desiring admiration, have strode among the enclosures; the praise-songs hailed the playing tawny one; the cows have indeed mixed with milk.
notes: The three -yu adjectives are uncertain. saṃvaraṇa 'enclosure' may also be 'choosing'. aśiśrayuḥ has no stated object, so none is supplied. The token payasedaśiśrayuḥ is payasā id aśiśrayuḥ. stubho'bhi is stubhaḥ abhi.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √pū, m. voc. sg.

hindi: यहाँ हमारे लिए, हे सोम, संयत, फूलते हुए पोषण को, हे बूँद, हे शुद्ध होने वाले, तरंग से बहाओ; जो हमारे लिए दिन में तीन बार दुहती है, अक्षय, अन्न से भरपूर, वाज वाला, मधु वाला, उत्तम वीर्य।
english: Hither, for us, O Soma, send flowing with the wave, O drop, O clarifying one, the restrained, swelling refreshment, which yields to us thrice in the day, unfailing: abounding in food, rich in prize, rich in the sweet drink, good heroism.
notes: Obscure in places. pavasva with an object is read as 'send flowing' (Hindi बहाओ). asaścuṣī 'unfailing' is uncertain. kṣumat is not split at -mat.

hindi: कोई भी कर्म से उसे नहीं पाता जिसने सदा बढ़ने वाले को बनाया; इन्द्र की तरह यज्ञों से सबके स्वागत-योग्य, बलवान, अपराजेय, साहसी को बल से।
english: No one reaches him by action who has made the ever-increasing one; like Indra, welcomed by all with sacrifices, mighty, unassailed, bold with strength.
notes: The structure is uncertain. na before indram is read as 'like' and the accusatives as in apposition to sadāvṛdham. kiṣṭam is read as kiḥ tam; the ṣ is not flagged. 'ṛbhvasa' is rendered 'mighty'.

words.gram: pres. part. pass. √jan, m. loc. sg.

hindi: अपराजित, उग्र, युद्धों में विजयी; जिसमें जन्म लेते समय महान, विस्तृत गति वाली गायें साथ गरजीं; आकाश, पृथ्वियाँ गरजे।
english: The unconquered, the fierce, the overcomer in battles; in whom, as he was born, the great wide-ranging cows roared together; the heavens, the earths roared.
notes: The first line is verbless accusatives. mahīḥ urujrayaḥ is taken with dhenavaḥ. 'as he was born' translates the locative absolute jāyamāne; the pronoun is the relative's antecedent.

hindi: हे मित्रो, आकर बैठो, शुद्ध होने वाले के लिए आगे गाओ; शिशु की तरह यज्ञों से चारों ओर सजाओ, शोभा के लिए।
english: O friends, come and sit down; sing forth for the one being purified. Adorn all round with sacrifices, like a child, for splendour.
notes: Reused from a reviewed final after checking; the earlier 'adorn him' supplied a pronoun, now removed.

hindi: उसे साथ मिलाओ, माताओं के साथ बछड़े की तरह, गृह को सिद्ध करने वाले को, देवों को प्रसन्न करने वाले मद की ओर, दुगुने बलवान को।
english: Mix him together, like a calf with mothers, the winner of the household, toward the exhilaration that pleases the gods, the doubly mighty.
notes: The 3 inside devāvyā3ṃ is a pluta mark, its own word, not translated. devāvī 'pleasing the gods', gaya 'household' and dviśavas 'doubly mighty' are uncertain.

hindi: कौशल सिद्ध करने वाले को पवित्र करो, जैसे दल के लिए, उपभोग के लिए; जैसे मित्र के लिए, वरुण के लिए, सबसे कल्याणकारी।
english: Purify the one who accomplishes skill, as for the host, for enjoyment; as for Mitra, for Varuṇa, the most beneficial.
notes: śardha 'host, troop' and vīti 'enjoyment' are choices. śantama is not split.

hindi: धावक आगे बहा, हज़ार धाराओं वाला, छन्ने के पार, भेड़ के बाल की छन्नी में से।
english: The racer flowed forth, thousand-streamed, across the filter, through the strainer of fleece.
notes: One-line unit of three pādas; no grouping change proposed.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √mṛj, m. nom. sg.
pres. part. mid. √śrī, m. nom. sg.

hindi: वह धावक बहा, हज़ार धाराओं वाला, जलों से शुद्ध किया जाता हुआ, दूध से मिलाया जाता हुआ।
english: He, the racer, flowed, thousand-flowing, being cleansed with waters, being mixed with milk.
notes: reta 'seed, stream' is a choice. gobhiḥ literally 'cows'.

words.gram: pres. part. pass. √yam, m. nom. sg.

hindi: हे सोम, आगे जाओ इन्द्र के पेट में, मनुष्यों से थामे गए, पत्थरों से निचोड़े गए।
english: Go forth, O Soma, into the belly of Indra, held by men, pressed by stones.
notes: kukṣā is read as a locative (kukṣau). 'into' for the locative is a choice.

words.gram: n. loc. sg. (name of a place)

hindi: जो सोम दूर में, जो पास में निचोड़े जाते हैं, या जो वहाँ शर्यणावत् में।
english: The Somas that are pressed in the far distance, those in the near, or those yonder at Śaryaṇāvat.
notes: Śaryaṇāvat is kept as a place name, no more said. adaḥ is read as 'yonder'.

hindi: जो आर्जीकों में, कर्ताओं में, जो घरों के बीच में, या जो पाँच जनों में।
english: Those among the Ārjīkas, among the doers, those in the midst of the dwellings, or those among the five peoples.
notes: Ārjīka is kept as a name; kṛtvasu is uncertain (it may be a place or tribe name). The first token is ya for ye (aḥ/e sandhi before a vowel).

hindi: वे हमारे लिए यहाँ बहें, आकाश से वर्षा, उत्तम वीर्य; गूँजते हुए देव, बूँदें।
english: May they flow hither for us, rain from heaven, good heroism; the resounding gods, the drops.
notes: svānāḥ may stand for suvānāḥ; noted only. The sentence is read with rain and heroism in apposition to the verb's sense; no verb is supplied.

hindi: वत्स तुम्हारे मन को सबसे ऊँचे निवास से भी खींच लाए; हे अग्नि, मैं स्तुति के द्वारा तुम्हें चाहता हूँ।
english: May Vatsa draw your mind hither even from the highest abode; O Agni, I desire you with a song.
notes: Reused from a reviewed final after checking. vatsaḥ is taken as the sage's name; 'calf' is also possible.

hindi: क्योंकि तुम बहुत स्थानों में समान हो, सब दिशाओं में शक्तिशाली; युद्धों में हम तुम्हें पुकारते हैं।
english: For you are alike in many places, mighty along all directions; in battles we call you.
notes: sadṛṅ 'alike' is a choice; the doubled ṅ before asi is regular sandhi.

words.gram: pres. part. denom. √vāj, m. nom. pl.

hindi: युद्धों में हम वाज चाहते हुए सहायता के लिए अग्नि को पुकारते हैं, वाजों में अद्भुत उदारता वाले को।
english: In battles, desiring the prize, we call Agni for help, in the prizes, the one of wonderful bounty.
notes: Straightforward; vājeṣu 'in the prizes' is literal.

hindi: हे इन्द्र, हे सौ शक्तियों वाले, हे सर्वदर्शी, तुम हमारे लिए बल, पौरुष लाओ, और सेनाओं को जीतने वाला वीर यहाँ लाओ।
english: You, O Indra, bring us might, manly strength, O hundred-powered one, O all-surveying one; bring hither a hero who overcomes hosts.
notes: Reused from a reviewed final after checking; the earlier 'and' between the asyndetic accusatives is removed. vicarṣaṇe is the vocative of vicarṣaṇi (surveyor).

hindi: क्योंकि हे वसु, तुम हमारे पिता बने हो; हे सौ शक्तियों वाले, तुम माता बने हो; तब हम तुम्हारी कृपा माँगते हैं।
english: For you have become our father, O good one; you have become our mother, O hundred-powered one; then we beg your favour.
notes: babhūvitha is shared by both clauses. The printed ~ after tva is the regular nasal.

words.gram: pres. part. denom. √vāj, m. acc. sg.

hindi: हे बलवान, हे बहुतों से पुकारे गए, वाज चाहने वाले तुम्हें मैं पुकारता हूँ, हे बल से रचे गए; वह तुम हमें उत्तम वीर्य दो।
english: O strong one, O much invoked one, I address you, desiring the prize, O one made by might; that one, give us good heroism.
notes: Hindi वाज stands for vāja in vājayantam. sa is rendered 'that one' in both languages (Hindi वह तुम).

hindi: हे इन्द्र, हे अद्भुत, हे पत्थर के धारी, जो कुछ तुम्हारा दिया हुआ यहाँ मेरे पास नहीं है, हे धन पाने वाले, वह उदारता हमारे लिए दोनों हाथों से लाओ।
english: O Indra, wonderful one, whatever given by you is not here with me, O wielder of the stone, that bounty bring to us, O finder of wealth, with both hands.
notes: Reused from a reviewed final after checking. ubhayāhastyā is read as ubhayā hastyā ā; the form hastyā is uncertain. tvādātam 'given by you' (tvā for tvayā).

hindi: हे इन्द्र, जिसे तुम वरणीय मानते हो, वह दीप्तिमान यहाँ लाओ; हम तुम्हारे उस असीम दान को पाएँ।
english: What you consider desirable, O Indra, radiant, that bring hither; may we find that boundless giving of yours.
notes: The genitives after vidyāma are read as one phrase 'of that giving of yours, boundless'; dāvanaḥ could also be a nominative 'giver'. akūpāra 'boundless' is a choice.

hindi: तुम्हारा जो मन दिशाओं में प्राप्त करने योग्य है, प्रसिद्ध और महान है, उससे हे पत्थर के धारी, तुम दृढ़ों को भी, वाज को जीतने के लिए तोड़ देते हो।
english: That mind of yours which is to be attained in the directions, renowned, great: by that, O wielder of the stone, you break open even firm things, the prize, for winning.
notes: Verb darṣi governs both dṛḍhā and vājam; no 'and' is added. 'mind' is manas; whose-mind is te 'your'.
